messages:
Alex Chen: Heads-up: planning a staggered multi-zone rollout for v2.21.0 tomorrow. Need to lock cutoff times, warmup, and canary percentages across US / EU / APAC. Quick sync here please. :wave:

Maria Gomez: Thanks Alex. Could you post the UTC schedule? trying to dodge APAC core hours.

Alex Chen: Proposed UTC windows:
- US canary: 2027-06-16 00:45-03:15 UTC (warmup at 00:15)
- EU canary: 2027-06-16 07:30-10:00 UTC (warmup 07:00)
- APAC canary: 2027-06-16 17:30-20:30 UTC (warmup 17:00)
Full traffic shifts after each canary signoff.

Kim Patel: Branch freeze? cutoff for feature merges?

Alex Chen: Soft freeze 2027-06-15 16:00 UTC for non-critical features. Final changelog PR must be merged by 18:30 UTC. Only hotfixes after that (security fixes auto-exempt).

Rajiv Rao: Changelog is PR #4821 — added upgrade notes and private deploy steps. @Kim can you glance at the migration instructions?

Kim Patel: Will review tonight. If anything big I'll flag it. :mag_right:

Jin Park: Canary rollout pattern? durations and increments?

Alex Chen: Start 1% x 10m -> 5% x 15m -> 25% x 20m -> 100%. Abort threshold: error rate > 3x baseline or lat p95 > baseline+150ms. See runbook entry.

Oncall SRE: I'll be on-call for the US and APAC windows. deploy-bot will execute smoke tests after each increase. Keep an eye on regional SLOs and error budget.

deploy-bot: [automation] Scheduled rollout v2.21.0 canaries: US 2027-06-16T00:45Z, EU 2027-06-16T07:30Z, APAC 2027-06-16T17:30Z. Canary steps: 1%/5%/25%/100%. Runbook: /runbooks/releases/v2.21.

Maria Gomez: We should prime model caches and prefix-KV before each canary. Recommend starting priming 30m prior.

Alex Chen: Agreed. Warmup plan (UTC): US 00:15 priming start, EU 07:00, APAC 17:00. Also pre-warm any reserved GPU pools 45m before APAC window.

Kim Patel: Are there DB migrations included? That would affect rollback strategy.

Rajiv Rao: No blocking migrations. There's a lightweight cleanup job run online; we gate it to the 25% step and monitor replication lag.

Jin Park: I'll add the priming curl and smoke script to the ops runbook. Example priming call:

```
# prime caches for model-pool
curl -X POST -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN\" \
  https://deploy.internal/api/v1/priming?pool=llm-prod-us&mode=prefix
```

Alex Chen: Also bumping release tag: "release/v2.21.0". Build artifacts will be generated post-merge and uploaded to artifacts.redwood. Ensure integrity checks run.

infra-team: Will confirm GPU node warmups and autoscaler state. We'll also verify KMS access for private deployments won't be impacted.

Oncall SRE: Monitoring checklist for the rollout:
- p95/p99 latency per region
- error rate by endpoint & model variant
- token-cost-per-request
- replication lag for DBs
If any metric breaches abort thresholds, we'll revert traffic to previous variant immediately.

Rajiv Rao: Adding traffic shift example to runbook (ops snippet):

```
POST /internal/traffic-shift
{ "target": "release-v2.21", "percent": 25 }
```

Kim Patel: @infra-team can you also ensure we have capacity headroom for the EU window? Might need to bump dedicated pools for 2 hours.

infra-team: Confirmed: will schedule extra nodes for EU + APAC warmups and monitor GPU utilization.

Maria Gomez: I'll draft the customer-facing release note (UTC times included) after changelog merges. Will ping product for signoff.

Jin Park: Smoke tests I'll add: basic generate, embedding consistency check, and quick rerank sanity. Posting to runbook in ~45m.

Alex Chen: Summary action items:
- @Kim: review PR #4821 (by EOD)
- @Maria: finalize changelog & customer email draft
- @Jin: upload smoke + priming scripts to runbook
- @infra-team: confirm GPU warmup & autoscaler for EU/APAC
- @Oncall SRE: standby for the windows and lead rollback if needed

Oncall SRE: I'll coordinate handover for EU window coverage.

deploy-bot: [automation] Branch freeze enabled at 2027-06-15T16:00Z. Auto-merge paused for non-critical PRs.

Alex Chen: Thanks all — will post a final "go/no-go" update here two hours before the US canary. :shipit:

Kim Patel: LGTM, thanks. :thumbsup:

Maria Gomez: Sounds good, will follow up on changelog edits.

Rajiv Rao: Looping product for post-release checks.

deploy-bot: [automation] Thread archived to /ops/rollouts/2027-06-15-v2.21-metadata.json"
